about: I am an Informatics student at the Czech University of Life Sciences Prague and a current student at 42 Prague, focused on writing reliable, maintainable software through practical, project-based learning rather than theory alone.

My strongest experience is in C systems programming, C#/.NET desktop development, PostgreSQL database design, and full-stack web development with ASP.NET, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, applying object-oriented design, data structures, and software design principles to build software that behaves correctly under real constraints.

I am interested in backend engineering, systems programming, networking, cloud technologies, and automation. At the moment I am expanding into computer networking and Docker while preparing for the CCNA certification.
